why: follow-redirects (resolved 2026-10-23): axios's follow-redirects@^1.16.0 range now resolves to 1.16.1, which patches GHSA-q3jh-wrc6-jgq8 and GHSA-8r9p-f939-6h3c (also trivy CVE-2026-111755/111756); the lockfile was bumped and the two entries removed. image-size is only fixable by a framework major upgrade — expo@57 + react-native@0.72 — which is a migration, not a patch. It's BUILD-TIME tooling reached through metro/expo (image-size parser DoS), not a runtime path an external caller reaches. Tracked for the framework-upgrade work; the gate fails on anything NOT listed here. postcss/decode-uri-component/@xmldom/xmldom/uuid were previously accepted here too, but are now forced to patched versions via package.json overrides (trivy findings #83-88) and removed from this list — a baselined entry that has disappeared fails the gate on purpose, so don't re-add them without re-verifying the override still resolves. node-forge (RESOLVED 2026-11-02): the 2026-10-02 entry recorded 'No patched release exists (1.4.0 is latest; package unmaintained)' and was correct then, but 1.4.1 and 1.4.2 have since been published, so that reasoning no longer holds and the entry was dropped. GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv and the HIGH set that landed since — GHSA-7wch-p9px-956x, GHSA-jc66-7q78-782g, GHSA-8hrf-8g6f-7xwp, GHSA-hqq3-7jhf-c5jx, GHSA-5x38-2vff-x55p — all affect <=1.4.0 and are patched at 1.4.2, which package.json now forces via overrides (node-forge reached only through @expo/cli and @expo/code-signing-certificates, i.e. build/publish-time tooling). Same override mechanism raised decode-uri-component 0.5.0 -> 0.5.1 (GHSA-qr28-fpjm-wq7f, DoS via quadratic percent-decoding) and follow-redirects 1.16.1 -> 1.16.2 (GHSA-mrwp-f3q8-3g9p, cross-origin header leak on redirect); these three were the 7 remaining trivy HIGH findings in the lockfile, which is why the trivy-fs job and this one had the same root cause. braces (removed 2026-10-23): GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm was withdrawn by GitHub on 2026-10-23, so npm audit no longer reports it and the gate would fail on the stale entry.
